security_definer_function_verification.notes: Returns password_hash without any authorization checks. Missing role context validation compared to version in 046. CRITICAL: Anyone can call this to retrieve password hashes.
security_definer_function_verification.remediation_required: Add role context validation: IF current_setting('app.role', true) IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Security: No role context set';

security_definer_function_verification.notes: Returns password_hash without any authorization checks. Missing role context validation. Anyone can call this with any UUID to get password hashes.
security_definer_function_verification.remediation_required: Add role context validation and remove password_hash from return values unless needed for auth

security_definer_function_verification.notes: Returns password_hash and allows email enumeration without authorization. Missing role context validation. Could be abused for user reconnaissance.
security_definer_function_verification.remediation_required: Add role context validation and consider limiting return fields for non-auth purposes

security_definer_function_verification.notes: UPDATE function with no authorization checks. Anyone can change any user's email_hash. Could break authentication or hijack accounts.
security_definer_function_verification.remediation_required: Add role context validation and ownership verification (only user can change their own email hash)

security_definer_function_verification.notes: Read-only but exposes admin status without authorization. Could be used for privilege reconnaissance. Less critical but still requires protection.
security_definer_function_verification.remediation_required: Add role context validation to prevent unauthorized admin status checks
